proposedchanges.title: Emptywheel Questions Subpoena Investigation Involving Democratic Consulting Firm

The post characterized the inquiry as politically retaliatory. The available account does not identify the firm, reproduce the subpoena, or include prosecutors’ responses, so the alleged motive remains unresolved.
